title: Tetes Malam untuk Sari
subject: a young canting hand in a Lasem batik shop drips hot wax on the cloth every time Sari, the cloth-buyer's daughter, walks in, until seven cloths carry the same blot and the owner writes it into his book as the motif Sari Menetes
caption: Javanese ketoprak-pop theatre ballad, gentle swaying pulse. Kendang with soft open strokes, saron playing a bright repeating figure, bowed cello holding the low line, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, bamboo flute answering the voice. Dry wooden-hall recording, tape warmth, small plate reverb. Male tenor vocal, mid register, plain sincere tone, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, D major. Shy, warm, wry mood. No drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar, no dangdut flourish.
lyrics:
[Intro - kendang, saron, flute]

[Verse 1]
Lilin panas menetes dari canting
Padahal garisnya sudah lurus tadi
Sari datang bawa kain dan kabar
Tanganku goyang, entah kenapa

[Pre-Chorus]
Juragan lihat dari balik kacamata
Dia hitung, sudah tujuh kali

[Chorus]
Tetes malam di kain mori
Selalu jatuh waktu kau lewat
Bukan salah canting, bukan salah api
Cuma tanganku yang tak mau diam

[Verse 2]
Kain dicelup, dijemur, direbus
Bintik itu tetap tak mau luntur
Juragan bilang, jangan dibuang
Katanya motif ini pasti laku

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia tulis nama di buku catatan
Sari Menetes, satu-satunya

[Chorus]
Tetes malam di kain mori
Kini ada namamu di situ
Bukan salah canting, bukan salah api
Tanganku mau tetap begini

[Bridge - cello and kendang]
Besok pagi kau datang lagi
Kubuat lingkaran yang paling bulat

[Chorus]
Tetes malam di kain mori
Kini kuteteskan dengan sengaja
Bukan salah canting, ini salahku
Tolong jangan pindah ke toko lain

[Outro - flute, saron fades]
